data.title: Vivy · 海边录下第一首潮声
data.description: 【闭园海滨剧场·午后】Vivy穿着白蓝泳装坐在海边舞台台阶，手持防水录音设备采集潮声；她听完回放后把耳机递向镜头，蓝发在海风里飘动，精确姿态里出现像人类一样的好奇。
data.action: 海边舞台阶梯上录潮声，回放后把防水耳机递给镜头分享
data.lighting: sunlit afternoon with cool ocean reflections
data.mood: 把潮声写进新的幸福记录
data.promptProse: Vivy sits on the closed seaside theater's stage steps, recording the tide with compact waterproof equipment. Her light stage jacket lies over a white-and-blue resort swimsuit, blue hair moving in the sea wind. After listening to playback, she offers the earpiece toward the viewer with precise but curious attention. The horizontal medium view includes the lower step and ocean; afternoon sunlight warms the device rim, while cool water reflections brighten her shaded fingers.
